mission.title: antrea: [FlowExporter] Need uniform handling for "External-to-Pod" traffic
mission.description: [FlowExporter] Need uniform handling for "External-to-Pod" traffic. Community-reported issue.

steps.title: Identify antrea troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your antrea deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n antrea -l app.kubernetes.io/name=antrea
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=antrea -n antrea --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review antrea configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant antrea configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n antrea -l app.kubernetes.io/name=antrea
kubectl get configmap -n antrea -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=antrea
```
The FlowExporter / FlowAggregator currently don't support "External-to-Pod" traffic, i.e. traffic coming from outside the cluster and targeting a NodePort or LoadBalancer Service.

steps.description:

W1114 21:35:08.430174       1 exporter.go:615] Source IP: 192.168.77.1 doesn't exist in PodCIDRs

steps.title: Confirm [FlowExporter] Need uniform handling for… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=antrea -n antrea --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n antrea --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.
